uv_contract.principle: MD Unified UV Coordinates export lays each pattern piece into a shared [0,1] texture region per fabric. Preserve that region mapping through the whole round-trip so per-layer textures land on the correct panels.
uv_contract.source_uv_state: SM_ShorewakeDress_48MAT_v2_slotted.obj has 31,664 UVs for 186,955 faces - sparse/overlapping per-panel islands not transfer-ready for MD; the pattern pass re-lays UVs per MD piece.
uv_contract.channel_policy: Keep a single UV0 channel per draped mesh, one UV region per MD pattern piece (Unified UV coordinates). Strip/Avoid multi-channel cloth layouts.
uv_contract.region_to_layer_binding: Each MD pattern region is tagged with the source garment layer name SW_Dress_Pxx -> M_Layer so texture assignment is deterministic.
uv_contract.draped_remap_rule: After MD export the draped mesh inherits the MD unified UV layout. Do NOT re-unwrap in UE; swap textures only. If UVs drift re-run UV transfer from the .zpac pattern via FBX Preserve Area UV so seamless cymatic/refresh maps still tile.
uv_contract.seamless_invariant: All garment_refresh and cymatic PBR maps are seamless/tiling at 2K (seed 20260902), so UV layout exactness matters only for large-patch occlusion/parallax orientation - cheap insurance for free MD re-layout.
uv_contract.y_flip: Normal maps are height-derived OpenGL Y+ (flip G on UE import). Preserve this in the import pipeline.
uv_contract.animated_flipbook: cymatic/animated/ FrameNN flipbook (8 frames phase 0==2pi) applies per-layer via a flipbook param; UV region must be stable across frames (single UV0).

texture_transfer_contract.contract: Cymatic / seasonal / refreshed PBR maps are re-applied onto MD-imported draped meshes via the verified small master family. Never a new master.

map_sources.cymatic: Saved/Audit/melusina_lookdev/garment_refresh/cymatic/ T_Cymatic_Garment_Layer_BaseColor/Normal/Height/Roughness/Metallic/Iridescence/Emissive/ORM/Opacity.png - 9 maps per layer + animated flipbook + cymatic_garment_manifest.json. Present.

texture_transfer_contract.opacity_policy: Opaque garment layers Bodice_* Sleeve Underskirt Skirt_Full use Opacity 1.0 opaque. Only Collar and Shoulder_Trim bind Opacity from the cymatic set for lace alpha coverage. Ornament uses no alpha.
texture_transfer_contract.selection_rule: Where cymatic (active sing) and garment_refresh (Moon neutral) both exist, default to garment_refresh for neutral derived maps and swap to cymatic for emissive/iridescence audio lanes. Seasonal variants (seasons/, empty today) override neutral BaseColor/Iridescence when bound.
